title: Construction of octanuclear polyoxomolybdenum(V)-based porous materials with lithium additives
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,30062-30070
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03010B, Paper
Open Access

Cheng Liu, Zhen-Lang Xie, Xin Dong, Wan-Ting Jin, Yi-Xin Lian, Zhao-Hui Zhou
POMs 1–4 contain 4.6 Å ring-shaped pores formed by eight cyclically connected molybdenum-oxygen groups. Using 1 as the framework, Li+ ions are bound to mono-/di-/tetranuclear hydrated units, forming complexes 2–4. The pores enable O2/CO2 adsorptions.
